opportunities.title: Sharp complete finite-p power profile for faithful KMS quantum Markov semigroups
opportunities.proposed_theorem: For every finite 1<p<infinity, finite faithful sigma and positive sigma-KMS QMS generator L, E_p(f)>=p sin(pi/p)/(2(p-1)) E_2(I_2,p(f)) for all positive f and all finite untouched references with arbitrary joint positive inputs; this universal coefficient is optimal even among primitive generators. The same profile and universal optimum hold under explicitly signed-Hermitian and polar complex conventions.
opportunities.status: Internally proved and physically audited; external/formal verification and priority unresolved.
opportunities.historical_importance: An exact complete Dirichlet power comparison can remove a regularity hypothesis from correctly normalized finite-dimensional KMS applications. Historical novelty and strongest known prior comparison have not been established by this phase.

primary_benchmark.title: Kastoryano and Temme, Quantum logarithmic Sobolev inequalities and rapid mixing, arXiv1207.3261v2
primary_benchmark.scope: Weighted powers, Dirichlet forms, Definitions7-9, Proposition8 and secant interpolation; literal printed higher-p factor is separately refuted, not silently amended.

opportunities.strongest_prior_work_assessment: UNKNOWN; the primary benchmark is verified, but no comprehensive priority assessment is claimed.
opportunities.new_internal_mechanism: Own sign-sensitive full coherent-frequency Gram plus a one-ratio Hardy boundary identity and multiplier hyponormality. Transfer-origin alternative two-multiplier proof and compactness/real-node-density upper construction are separately exposed and audited. Root-origin 2x2 Hermitian dilation transfers the signed profile to complex polar powers.
opportunities.load_bearing_obligation: No internal finite-dimensional positivity or physical-sharpness gap remains in the reviewed argument. External/formal validation of the exact weighted transports, full representation, both signed kernels and legal upper construction remains decisive.
compatibility_obligations: Preserve positive Heisenberg generator sign, physical stationary sandwiches and p-versus-conjugate-p normalization.
Retain cross-frequency coherent terms and all ordered full-state pairs.
Distinguish original positive powers from explicitly signed/polar conventions.
Do not assert KT's literal printed(p-1) weak branch for p>2.
Universal optimum allows arbitrarily large finite dimension and poorly conditioned faithful sigma; no fixed-dimension or resource-bounded acquisition optimum is claimed.
opportunities.early_falsification_control: The printed source branch was falsified by an exact classical p3 reset example; the actual profile was proved analytically. The exposed physical Hessian congruence also passed one exact mixed-sign radical identity check, classified solely as a normalization check.
opportunities.likely_significance_if_externally_establ: A sharp complete comparison profile for the full finite-dimensional KMS class, with explicit real/complex input conventions and matching legal primitive upper witnesses.
opportunities.ambitious_endpoint_boundary: Infinite-dimensional normal QMS, infinity endpoint, all-complex p1 entropy, non-KMS generators and efficient uniformly conditioned witness acquisition are not established.

rejected_analogies: A negative abstract kernel alone is not a physical refutation; the leaf-noise Hessian realizes it legally.
A literal source typo counterexample is not a foundational discovery.
Finite exact replay, multiple model agreement and internal audit are not external validation or historical novelty.
